distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 138.3400 +/- 0.3177 mas (same row, RUWE 7.28): 7.23 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.7949 +/- 0.0062 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 105: mass 0.767 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
